inv.desc_es:
De particular. Abstenerse agencias. Local ubicado en el centro de Barcelona, al lado de Palau de Generalitat de Catalunya, en una calle muy comercial. 
Local tiene 165 m2 distribuido en 2 plantas. Tiene fachada y ventanas por 2 calles. Calle Call y calle Ferran. Las 2 plantas están conectadas por escalera interior. Mucha luz natural. Recien reformado.
El local esta totalmente equipado. Dispone de todo equipacion para cafeteria, bar, restaurante: mesas, sillas, y un baño con los servicios de caballeros y señoras, un almacén, la cocina.
Dispone de la licencia C3.
Está conectado con gas. Ideal para tapasbar, pizzería, restaurante.
Está alquilado. Rentabilidad 5%.

Comunicar por 6.2. 8. 2.9. 7. 1.3. 0.
inv.desc_en:
In particular. Refrain agencies. Local located in the center of Barcelona, a few meters from Plaza Sant Jaume, next to Palau de Generalitat de Catalunya, on a very commercial street. With a very intense crowd of passers-by and tourists.
Local has 165 m2 distributed over 2 floors. It has a façade and windows on 2 streets. Call Street and Ferran Street. The 2 floors are connected by an internal staircase. Lots of natural light. Newly renovated.
The place is fully equipped. It has all the equipment for a cafeteria, bar, restaurant: tables, chairs, and a bathroom with men's and women's toilets, a warehouse, the kitchen.
It has the C3 license.
Working 24 hours a day, selling alcohol and tobacco is allowed.
It is connected to gas. Ideal for tapas bar, pizzeria, restaurant.
Two sales options: without tenant or with tenant. CONTRACTUAL CONDITIONS: €5,500 per month plus VAT, 10-year contract, mandatory compliance for 2 years. Profitability 5.5% annually.
In particular.
